_comment: Orphan fixture: two closed epics with leftovers, plus the near-misses that must NOT count. Kept separate from fixture.issues.json so the baseline render keeps asserting the clean/empty case.

issues.title: Closed epic with leftovers
issues.description: Marked done while work was still inside.

issues.title: Stranded open task
issues.description: Open, but its epic was closed.

issues.title: Stranded deferred task
issues.description: Deferred is not terminal — also stranded.

issues.title: Finished before the close
issues.description: Done inside a done epic — correctly closed out, not an orphan.

issues.title: Nested under a stranded task
issues.description: Its own parent (orph0001) is open, so re-homing that one moves this too.

issues.title: Rejected epic with leftovers
issues.description: Won't-do epic that still contains open work.

issues.title: Stranded under a rejected epic
issues.description: A rejected epic strands its children exactly like a done one.

issues.title: Live epic
issues.description: Still open — its children are not orphans.

issues.title: Ordinary child of a live epic
